start:
@startuml
(*) --> "Receive Order"
"Receive Order" --> [paid] "Check Stock"
if "In stock?" then
  --> [yes] "Ship Order"
else
  --> [no] "Back Order"
endif
"Ship Order" --> (*)
"Back Order" --> (*)
@enduml
